instruction: Candid documentary full shot of a forest trail. On the left, the older man with a white beard (R1) in a rust shirt stands in profile. On the right, the curly-haired youth (R2) in a yellow plaid shirt bends forward, stumbling. The older man (R1) places his right hand on the shoulder of the youth (R2) to steady him. Sun-dappled light filters through the trees.
